notes: Custom Danish/Nordic webshop platform (Proshop, used across DK/SE/FI). 21 products, all on one page (page shows '21 products' count, no pagination controls found). Stock logic NORMAL: '.site-icon-stock-in' class present = in stock ('Varastossa'); other stock-icon variants seen (site-icon-stock-comming = incoming/backorder, e.g. 'Tukkurilla, 3-6 arkipäivää') should be treated as NOT in stock for a simple in/out model. Price is '.site-currency-lg' (the customer-facing price); a second parenthesized price in '.hidden-xs' next to it is the ex-VAT/business price and should be ignored.
